query:
UPDATE sales 
SET saleDate = DATE_ADD(saleDate, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND YEAR(saleDate) IN (2023, 2024)
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
